author: Jaime Botero
releaseNotes: 0.235 (stable): Flair Vents integration with the established Dynamic Airflow Balancing strategy and the latest reviewed fixes. Delivered as a single Hubitat Bundle (app + Flair vents driver).
betaReleaseNotes: 0.238 (beta): Fixes throttle-deferred API retries crashing puck sensor processing (MissingMethodException: sendEvent ... LazyMap in handlePuckReadingGetWithCache) by keeping device objects out of scheduler data, and stops deferred retries from overwriting each other - previously all but the last deferred request in a poll burst were silently dropped, which could keep a newly added Puck 2 from ever being discovered. Repairs the rooms-relationships puck discovery path (dead code since 0.236). Fan-only circulation now also engages when the fan is forced on while the system is idle (new thermostatFanMode subscription with debounce). Adds a Settings Reference to the README. Retains the full DAB v2 'balance' feature set; existing installs keep the legacy DAB strategy by default.
